Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :s_unit_count = 0 then
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select batch_id
 into :batch_id
 from batch_inputs
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and substr(batch_id,8,2) = 'CB'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;

 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
 select count(*)
 into :s_unit_count
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :s_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select cue_scan_flag into :cue_scan_flag
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

end;

Item.Name: EXCEPTION_FLAG
Item.Hint: Enter 'Y' to view only units with exceptions, 'N' for all units.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
nullchk ;
check_package_failure ;
if :exception_flag not in ('Y','N') then
 show_error('0070') ;
 check_package_failure ;
elsif :exception_flag = 'Y' then
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and (red_tube_flag is null or
 purple_tube_flag is null or
 serum_plasma_ind is null or
 red_tube2 is null or
 (:cue_scan_flag = 'Y' and donor_decision_code is null))
 and rownum = 1 ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('2513') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if ;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_BATCH_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select b.batch_id from batch_inputs b where chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and substr(b.batch_id,8,2) = 'CB' and insert_dats between trunc(sysdate)-21 and sysdate and exists (select 'x' from units u where u.batch_id = b.batch_id and u.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id ) order by insert_dats desc
